title: Integrating Response-Network Evidence and Molecular Representations to Prioritize Ligand-Responsive Prokaryotic Transcription Factors: code and data
description: Code, curated response data, candidate protein sequences, evaluation partitions, and analysis results accompanying the manuscript Integrating Response-Network Evidence and Molecular Representations to Prioritize Ligand-Responsive Prokaryotic Transcription Factors. The original software is released under the MIT License; third-party data and assets retain their respective terms, as documented in the repository.
